name: Sirsa

queries.query: Sirsa Haryana official cadastral parcel map geoportal land records GIS
queries.result: First-party results identified Haryana Revenue and Disaster Management Department, HARSAC Digital Land Record System, Web-HALRIS and the State GIS Portal. The Revenue department page specifically discusses digitization of some Sirsa district village maps; HARSAC's current public landing page describes cadastral maps and land information but requires public-login OTP for its map application.

queries.query: सिरसा हरियाणा आधिकारिक भू नक्शा cadastral parcel map जमीन रिकॉर्ड
queries.result: Search results did not expose a separate Sirsa-specific anonymous parcel API. They surfaced the official HARSAC Digital Land Record System and national NAKSHA programme; the Haryana first-party systems remain the relevant local/state custodians.

registryBasis: First-party Haryana Revenue materials identify the state land-record/cadastral-map programme and explicitly mention Sirsa district village-map digitization; the Sirsa district revenue office/tehsil is listed by the same department. This establishes an official custodian and local administrative scope, not an open geometry feed.

officialSources.observation: Official department page says some Sirsa district mussavis were given to HARSAC for digitization and describes integration of village maps with Jamabandi land records.
Current HARSAC Digital Land Record System landing page advertises Haryana cadastral maps and land information; public map access is behind OTP login.
Official Haryana IT page identifies Web-HALRIS as the integrated deed-registration and land-records management system implemented in all tehsils.
Official Revenue department field-office listing includes Sirsa.
